rationale: Debugger pause transitions suppress DOM EventTarget listeners specifically when dispatched from Node socket callbacks in an integrated renderer; linked runnable repository exists. DevTools/node integration directly describe the boundary; webcontents.debugger and V8 are optional. contextIsolation, inspector.Session and suspend words do not identify context-bridge/session/powerMonitor problems. Wayland compositor input freezes are not the same JavaScript event-dispatch failure; Node controls differ, so no categorical upstream redirect.
